collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - VILLAGE MOMENTS (VFX-01..12, draft for the owner, 2026-11-18)
Songs, chants and speeches, a long lazy afternoon, rain on the way, a roof patched with cloth: small moments where the whole village does something together, and the island answers.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult)

collection.description: The new hut is nearly done: everyone helps, or the builders work at their own pace.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: The new hut is so close to finished that you can almost see it standing. (name1) wants to rally the whole village to help finish it before the season turns.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: Everyone who can carry a pole or tie a knot turns up. By evening the hut is almost done, and everyone is too tired to do anything but sit and admire it.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) decides the builders know what they are doing and leaves them to it. The hut goes up at its own steady pace.
